hypothesis: A bounded local residual-flow field captures spatially heterogeneous tissue motion missed by the global registered translation linker and improves edge associations on frozen detections.
parent: EXP190 fixed complete-graph policy: registered translation linker plus minimum component length 8 forward and 3 reverse.
data_and_protocol: Existing reciprocal embryo-disjoint 24-movie OOF coordinate caches; CPU-only and no image/model inference.
flow_definition: After the exact registered median shift, build mutual-nearest pseudo-correspondences within 4 um. At each source coordinate take the coordinatewise median residual of its 16 or 32 nearest paired sources, clip correction magnitude to 2 um, and blend at alpha .25 or .50. Preserve the 7 um Hungarian gate and 3 um motion scale.
selection: Leave-one-movie-out arm selection independently within each embryo direction, using only the other 11 movies. Full-data arm ranking is diagnostic only.
promotion_gate: Exact translation control within 1e-12; positive nested pooled delta; nonnegative nested delta in both directions; positive lower 95 percent bound from 20,000 direction-stratified paired movie bootstrap draws.
interpretation_guard: Failure rejects this local pseudo-flow family, not learned optical flow or appearance-aware association. Sequential 24-movie evidence cannot modify EXP192 before untouched confirmation.
resource: CPU-only on nsu-quadro inside the registered remote Kaggle root; no GPU lease required.
